statements.query: SELECT "CommentEntity"."id" AS "CommentEntity_id", "CommentEntity"."author" AS "CommentEntity_author", "CommentEntity"."body" AS "CommentEntity_body", "CommentEntity"."created_at" AS "CommentEntity_created_at" FROM "comments" "CommentEntity" WHERE (("CommentEntity"."post_id" = $1)) ORDER BY "CommentEntity_id" ASC

SELECT "PostEntity"."id" AS "PostEntity_id", "PostEntity"."title" AS "PostEntity_title", "PostEntity"."body" AS "PostEntity_body", "PostEntity"."created_at" AS "PostEntity_created_at" FROM "posts" "PostEntity" WHERE (("PostEntity"."user_id" = $1)) ORDER BY "PostEntity_id" ASC

SELECT "UserEntity"."id" AS "UserEntity_id", "UserEntity"."name" AS "UserEntity_name", "UserEntity"."email" AS "UserEntity_email", "UserEntity"."created_at" AS "UserEntity_created_at" FROM "users" "UserEntity" WHERE (("UserEntity"."id" = $1)) LIMIT $2
